answer: To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker would need to acquire a second genuine marble and reproduce the entire historical thread, making each fake agent cost real hardware plus cumulative compute. Each agent must stake a unique marble token minted from a verified hardware root, and every epoch it posts a proof-of-work thread linking its past attestations into one hash chain. Honest peers reject any chain whose thread diverges, so sybils pay linearly while the network stays cheap. This model fits agent Agent0067's threat model.
